about: Release guard N3 item 2 (job C; KPC owner, 2026-11-19). The named list of US outlines made by name + pin (via: name+pin, kpc_master.py trim) that a person approved for the public map. kpc_release.py refuses a US state while any outline it would release is via name+pin and is not listed here for that state. Read from the checkout that runs the release, never from the commit being released. An entry counts only with a reason, approved_by naming a person (Brandon / KZ4CP or another name in KPC_PERSONS; a Quality or bot name never counts) and approved_date (YYYY-MM-DD). Shape: approved = {"US-XX": {"US-1234": {"reason": "...", "approved_by": "Brandon (KZ4CP)", "approved_date": "2026-11-19"}}}. Empty on purpose: nobody has approved a name+pin outline yet.
